title: VPC health batch prober and adaptive priming runner
creator: Rohan Patel
description: Implement a resilient post-deploy health prober that runs as a batched orchestration for newly provisioned VPC/private deployments. This ticket covers two coordinated pieces: (1) a batch prober that executes API readiness checks, a staged model load/saturation test, and lightweight smoke assertions across routes and model variants; (2) an adaptive priming runner that warms KV caches and model weights using a traffic-profile-aware seeding strategy. Goal: reduce false-positive failures after private deploys, shorten mean time to readiness, and provide deterministic artifacts (logs, metrics, artifacts) for on-call and automation to make release gating decisions.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Batch prober runs automatically after terraform apply and reports a single consolidated readiness artifact (JSON) to the deployment bucket; 2) API readiness: endpoints return 200 within configured latency SLO for 95th percentile on smoke payloads; 3) Model load test: runtime successfully loads target model variants and sustains a 10s token-generation simulation for each variant without OOM/eviction; 4) Adaptive priming: KV cache hit-rate improves by >30% vs cold baseline for typical prompts; 5) Failure modes documented with automatic rollback hook (mark deploy as degraded) and Slack + pager alerts; 6) Test run reproducible via CI job and Terraform output exposes probe status.
technical_notes: Architectural design: a controller task (Kubernetes job or ephemeral ECS task depending on customer infra) pulls a per-deployment plan from the infra metadata service. The plan contains ordered probes: control-plane handshake, route-level smoke (simple text gen), model-load probe (container-level model instantiate + minimal token loop), then saturation probe (gradually ramped concurrent inference at low qps). The adaptive priming runner samples recent production prompt buckets (or synthetic seedset) and schedules priming sequences with backoff and concurrency caps. Metrics to emit: probe_duration_ms, probe_step, error_type, kv_cache_hit_rate, model_load_latency_ms, memory_peak_mb. Retries: exponential with jitter up to 3 attempts. Timeout for entire probe run default 30m (configurable per-customer).
comments: 2026-03-02 - Rohan Patel: Initial spike finished; prototype controller successfully executes smoke and model load steps in our staging VPC. Observed KV cache improvement after priming but intermittent 502s on route-level smoke—likely TLS handshake race on first call.

2026-03-03 - Ava Martinez: Reworked timeout and retry logic. Added explicit preflight TLS handshake probe and extended model instantiate timeout for quantized models. Created PR for Terraform module linking the job resource.

2026-03-05 - SRE review (Priya Singh): Requested more granular metrics for rate-limited failures and a circuit-breaker to abort saturation step if memory pressure reported >90% for two sequential checks.

2026-03-07 - Ava Martinez: Implemented circuit-breaker and memory-safety guard. Added feature flag to enable adaptive priming per-customer. Running 3 full runs against staging; one run failed due to kernel-selection mismatch—filed follow-up ENG-700322.

2026-03-09 - Design feedback (Sofia Klein): Suggested adding a short UX payload (console flow) summarizing readiness with 'safe-to-route' boolean and links to run artifacts. Will coordinate with Console team for dashboard tile.
2026-03-10 - Test results: Staging runs (n=5) show stable API readiness within 4s p95 and KV cache hit-rate improvement median 38%. Preparing CI job and final PR review.
test_plan: 1) Unit tests for probe step state machine; 2) Integration test: run prober against a staging VPC via terraform apply --auto-approve and validate readiness JSON is produced; 3) Load simulation: synthetic token generation scripts (scripts/load/saturate.py) to ensure no OOM; 4) CI gate: nightly job that runs prober against canary infra and fails on regressions.
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged rollout: start with internal-only accounts, then opt-in enterprise customers. For Dedicated capacity customers enable priming off by default until we have per-tenant tuning. Add telemetry review at +24h and +72h after first enabling for each tenant.
